Team / Sarah,

Following the close of Q2, Finance ran the variance report and flagged a shortfall versus quota for our Q3 target tied to the Acme expansion. I pulled the latest exports and attached a trimmed CSV (Q3_pipeline_export.csv) plus a MAP template (MAP_template_v2.xlsx).

Ask: please review the sheet and update the Stage/Commit field for any open deals that have moved in the last 10 days. I want to lock a 30-minute triage on Wednesday to agree a prioritized action matrix (who owns outreach, expected close date, blocker, and contingency).

Quick context: the variance comes from three mid-size deals slipping (two to next quarter, one at-risk). If we can recover even 40% of the at-risk amount via acceleration or partial scope, it materially reduces the shortfall.

Proposed triage agenda:
- Confirm updated commit / stage for each target deal (5 min)
- Assign outreach owner + messaging (10 min)
- Short-term mitigation offers (discounts, engineering help, pilot scope) (10 min)
- Follow-up cadence & HubSpot tasks (5 min)

Please update the CSV before 11am PT on Wed. I will send a calendar invite once we have confirmation on attendees.

Attachments: Q3_pipeline_export.csv, MAP_template_v2.xlsx

Thanks,
